profile.headline: Software Engineer in San Francisco Bay Area
profile.summary:
I am currently a Software Engineer in the Bay Area, with interests including distributed systems, compilers and programming language design, software security, and computer science education.

I received a degree in Computer Science from the University of Michigan's College of Engineering, along with minors in Math and Entrepreneurship.

A full list of my academic and personal projects can be found on my personal website.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: SDE II at Annapurna Labs working on AWS Trainium and Inferentia

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Specialist (Embedded Systems) working on PyTorch for embedded devices

• Built runtime library to execute PyTorch machine learning models on
memory-limited, embedded device architectures
• Designed and implemented novel user debug tracing and error handling
• Optimized ARM binary build size from 300MB to under 20KB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Specialist (Systems) working in Operating Systems at Reality Labs

• Designed and implemented async RPC tracing library and aggregation server
• Owned distributed, async, structured logging system and client libraries
• Modernized process initialization and bring-up for async operating system

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Specialist (Systems) working in Operating Systems at Oculus

• Built secure, user-space ELF binary object loader for async operating system
• Implemented core service registry to facilitate RPC between microservices
• Implemented RPC library in C using custom-built async runtime library

positions.title: Instructional Aide
positions.description:
•	Instructed a weekly lab for EECS 388: Introduction to Computer Security
•	Held weekly office hours for students in the course
•	Supervised project, homework, and final exam question creation

projects.title: Decentralized Election System
projects.description:
Won the National Cutler-Bell Prize in High School Computing from the Computer Science Teachers Association.

A new strategy for internet voting that will encourage and enable all citizens to participate, providing a solution which would change the way people vote in a democracy using the BlockChain technology popularized by BitCoin.

projects.title: MjolnirCraft
projects.description: PHP based Web Application using MySQL databases. Original HTML and CSS design with secure PHP coding.

testScores.name: DE Principles of Engineering
testScores.description: This course was Dual-Enrolled with Rochester Institute of Technology through their Project Lead the Way. 9 is the highest score achievable on their final exam and certifies a thorough understanding of engineering concepts.
